objective.text: Render multiple pushed assets at a stack rather than treating pushes as a single section.

difficulty.rationale: Accumulate contributions instead of overwriting one named section.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: Two independently included partials each contribute one script tag. The layout must output both contributions in push order. Which Blade arrangement is designed for this?

options.text: Each partial uses @stack("scripts"); the layout uses @push("scripts").
options.rationale: This reverses contribution and rendering: stack reads while push writes.
options.misconception: This reverses contribution and rendering: stack reads while push writes.

options.text: Each partial uses @push("scripts"); the layout renders @stack("scripts").
options.rationale: A stack accumulates multiple pushes for later rendering in the chosen location.

options.text: Each partial defines @section("scripts") without @parent; the layout uses @yield("scripts").
options.rationale: Repeated section definitions without parent composition do not express independent accumulated pushes.
options.misconception: Repeated section definitions without parent composition do not express independent accumulated pushes.

options.text: The layout uses @includeIf("scripts") without registering a scripts view.
options.rationale: Optional inclusion looks up a view; it does not collect script contributions from partials.
options.misconception: Optional inclusion looks up a view; it does not collect script contributions from partials.
